messages:
Maya (Design): quick design check: the batch embeddings preview has accessibility and layout issues when the table is narrowed. legend + actions wrap and push the export button off-screen.
Ravi (Eng): can we collapse legend into an icon that expands inline? cheaper than a sticky header.
Maya (Design): concern: hidden legend hurts context. prefer sticky header that keeps actions visible.
Nora (A11y): sticky header ok but legend swatches need text labels and aria names. color-only indicators fail contrast tests.
Ethan (PM): product ask: keep export within the header area so users export the preview they're interacting with. last time export moved and caused confusion.
Sofia (ML): rerank score needs clearer context. showing raw 0.76 confuses product folks. add "(0-1)" suffix or a short explanation.
Nora (A11y): avoid tooltip-only explanations. add an sr-only descriptive node and reference it with aria-describedby for each score cell.
Ravi (Eng): performance note: rendering thousands of rows is costly. suggest limiting preview to 150 rows and showing a banner: "Previewing 150 of 8,724 vectors. Export will include all unless sampled."
Maya (Design): banner copy: "Previewing 150 of 8,724 vectors. Export all or choose a sample." must be dismissible and announceable to assistive tech.
Nora (A11y): banner use role=note and a visible close button with aria-label="Dismiss preview notice". ensure focus order and no trapping.
Ethan (PM): export modal rename: "Download vectors" -> "Export vectors (CSV)" and add subtext: "Includes id, dimensions (truncated), rerank_score". add sample options (First N, Random, Stratified).
Sofia (ML): sampling defaults: Random 1,000; include a short blurb about representativeness.
Ravi (Eng): implementation: legend left, density toggle center, export/actions right. will add sr-only descriptions, aria-describedby for scores, and cap preview rows.
ci-bot: preview deployed for branch design/batch-legend-refactor: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/batch-legend-refactor
Maya (Design): I'll run a keyboard/navigation pass and update the mock. Nora, can you test VoiceOver/NVDA when PR is up?
Nora (A11y): yes. blocking only if aria-describedby/live region approach isn't in PR.
Ravi (Eng): planning to open PR tonight.
Ethan (PM): timeline: aim to ship behind FF next sprint.
Maya (Design): thanks all, adding notes to the design doc. :thumbsup:
